posts.title: Anthropic Just Published the Answer Key for Always-On Agents. So I Did the Most Rational Thing: I Marked My Own Assistant
posts.description: On 13 November, Anthropic published a long guide to building always-on AI agents and split them into five parts: an event inbox, timers, memory, permissions and an outbox. I checked the AI assistant that lives in my inbox against it. The inbox and the outbox were fully right, because email already comes with an inbox, an outbox and an approve button. posts.title: Baidu Says Only Two Kinds of Jobs Will Be Left in the Organization of the Future
posts.description: Robin Li says the jobs of the future will converge into two kinds: builders and sellers. Boris Cherny, who created Claude Code, made a list too, with five archetypes. Neither list has a manager on it. Tencent's leadership told staff it may not need so many management roles, and ByteDance made "stay close to the front line" a principle of its own.
